title: Example - fish and chips reel
idea: One plate of fish and chips is made in a calm, warm motion and ends complete on the table.

shots.reason: fries in the air: a motion hook in frame 0, real 50 fps slow motion (clean conform)
the cook and the kitchen give the place; real fryer sound, barely there; a touch brighter and warmer to match shot 1
the fish is flipped: real time, slowing to 50% at the top of the flip, back to real time
the complete plate: the result, held longest
designed end card (made elsewhere), on the music's last chord

notes: Free text: why rules were broken on purpose, open questions.

_fields._: Documentation only (keys starting with _ are ignored). Paths are relative to this plan's folder or absolute.
_fields.title, idea, structure, register: idea = the one sentence the whole film obeys; register luxury|premium|brand|social|hype sets the ASL range
_fields.music: file (use the WAV beats.py wrote), start (s into the track), fade_in, fade_out (s), gain_db, beats (beats.json)
_fields.shots[].src / in / out: camera file and source seconds; a .png/.jpg src is a still shown for 'duration' seconds
_fields.shots[].duration: seconds on screen, for still pictures only
_fields.shots[].speed: 0.5 = half speed. Clean conform = timeline fps / capture fps (50p on 25p = 0.5)
_fields.shots[].ramp: [[source_s, k], ...] from 0 to out-in; k = slowdown (1 real time, 2 half speed); smooth between keys; replaces speed
_fields.shots[].interpolate: true = synthesise missing frames (minterpolate) when the clip has too few for the slowdown; check every frame
_fields.shots[].optical_flow_ok: true = you checked an uneven speed frame by frame (silences the clean-conform warning)
_fields.shots[].lut: camera maker's official log-to-Rec.709 .cube; plan_check/lutcheck verify it really converts the log
_fields.shots[].grade: gentle, after the LUT: exposure (stops), temp -1..1 (+ warm), tint -1..1 (+ magenta), contrast 0.8..1.2, saturation 0.8..1.2
_fields.shots[].stabilize: true | "vidstab": two-pass vid.stab (crop-safe zoom); 8-bit 4:2:0 for that shot; no rolling-shutter fix; skipped with a warning when ffmpeg has no vid.stab
_fields.shots[].rotate: EXTRA rotation 90|180|270; the camera's rotation flag is already applied by ffmpeg, so normally leave it out
_fields.shots[].reframe: {x, y: focal point 0-1 of the source, zoom >= 1}
_fields.shots[].push: [start_scale, end_scale] eased digital push (e.g. [1.0, 1.04]); keep to at most ~1/3 of shots
_fields.shots[].transition: cut (default) | dissolve:FRAMES (overlaps both shots; the film gets shorter by FRAMES)
_fields.shots[].role: hook | build | turn | hero | end | accent | breath | end-card
_fields.shots[].reason: why the shot is here, what it does for the idea
_fields.shots[].text: text that will be laid over this shot (timing check only; burn designed text in with overlays)
_fields.shots[].sound_db: keep the shot's own sound at this gain (real-time shots only)
_fields.overlays[]: designed PNG with alpha (end card, logo, title made elsewhere): png, start, end (film seconds), fade (frames, opacity only), x, y (top-left px; default centred), scale (fraction of output width), opacity 0-1
